children: Subramanian will take charge on November 30, 2026, while Balfour Manuel will continue as Senior Strategic Advisor until May 2027 to support the transition

Blue Dart Express has announced a planned leadership transition, with R.S. Subramanian set to take over as Managing Director from November 30, 2026, subject to the requisite approvals. He will succeed Balfour Manuel, who will step down as Managing Director on November 29 after a 43-year association with the company.

As part of the transition, Manuel will continue with Blue Dart as Senior Strategic Advisor until May 15, 2027. The role is intended to support continuity across the company’s strategic priorities during the leadership change.

Manuel joined Blue Dart in 1983 as one of the company’s early employees and has spent more than four decades with the organisation. He became Managing Director in 2019 and has overseen the company through a period of network expansion and capability development.

“Blue Dart has been the defining journey of my professional life. After careful consideration, I believe this is the right time to implement a structured succession plan that serves the company’s long-term interests. I have every confidence in R.S. Subramanian, who understands our business, respects our culture and shares our ambition. As Senior Strategic Advisor, I look forward to working closely with him and the Board to ensure continuity throughout the transition,” says Balfour Manuel.

Subramanian brings nearly four decades of experience across product and service businesses, with expertise in strategy, customer experience, organisational transformation and profitable growth. He currently serves as Senior Vice President, DHL Express South Asia, and Managing Director, DHL Express India, overseeing operations across India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, the Maldives and Bhutan. He is also a member of the DHL Express Asia Pacific Management Board.

Associated with DHL Express since 2004, Subramanian has led businesses across growth and transformation initiatives, with a focus on customer experience, service quality and organisational capabilities. He has also served as a Director on the Board of Blue Dart since 2019, giving him an existing understanding of the company and its strategic priorities.

“It is a privilege to lead Blue Dart, an institution that has played a defining role in the development of India's express logistics industry. Having served on the Blue Dart Board over the past seven years, I have had the opportunity to gain a firsthand appreciation of the company's strong customer focus, operational excellence and the culture that the team has built,” says R.S. Subramanian.

He adds, “I also want to acknowledge Balfour's remarkable contribution to Blue Dart over more than four decades and the strong foundation he leaves for the future. As India's economy continues to grow and connect with global markets, logistics will remain a critical enabler of business success. My focus will be on building on Blue Dart’s strong foundation, advancing its market leadership and delivering sustainable, profitable growth, while continuing to create value for customers, employees and shareholders alike.”

The appointment comes as part of a planned succession process at Blue Dart, with the company looking to maintain continuity while transitioning its leadership. Subramanian’s existing experience with Blue Dart’s Board and his leadership role within DHL Express provide continuity with the company’s wider logistics network.
